pairs.l: 1 — Why don't we spend a quiet evening at home? Watch a movie or relax.
2 — I've bought a new desk. Can you come over and help me carry it up the stairs?
3 — Steve's offered us to stay in his flat! He of all people! I can't believe it!
4 — It's a second-hand car, so be careful if you plan to buy it.
5 — You didn't hand in the report on time. Can you give me an explanation?

r1.exp: Poruka 1 (tiha večer kod kuće, film ili čaj) = D (Let's stay in). Poruka 2 (treba pomoć s nošenjem pisaćeg stola) = E (Give me a hand). Poruka 3 (nevjerojatno da je Steve ponudio stan) = A (I'm amazed). Poruka 4 (rabljeni auto — pazi) = F (Watch out). Poruka 5 (zašto kasniš s izvještajem?) = B (Tell me why).

r6.exp: 'I got a coupon for a FREE WEEKEND IN LONDON for two, which I couldn't ignore' → putovanje = B (Because of a trip).

r7.exp: Deadline je utorak, Luke poziva u srijedu ('day before the exam'), ispiti se označavaju do četvrtka → ispit je u ČETVRTAK = C.

r8.exp: Mama svako jutro + Nina svake večeri = SVAKI DAN (A). Vikendi su samo za ispitno razdoblje, ne normalno.

r9.exp: 'It feels good when you complete a report that MAKES YOUR CLIENT HAPPY' = zadovoljstvo/nagrada = B (rewarding).

r10.exp: 'You have to come over with the LATEST DATA' → Sarah traži od Claire najnovije podatke = B (The data).

r11.exp: 'or QUACKY, as his audiences will remember him' → scensko ime je Quacky.

r12.exp: 'Worked as a CLERK for five years' → prvi posao je bio clerk (činovnik).

r13.exp: 'Made his film DEBUT in WONDERFUL TIME' → prvi film je Wonderful Time.

r14.exp: 'With the family at home in CANADA' → zemlja stanovanja je Kanada.

r15.exp: 'My SISTER AND I' → sin i kćer = dvoje djece.

r16.exp: 'Practise your smile in the mirror. You'll know (16)____.' → E: when it looks the most natural. Vježbanje ispred ogledala da naučiš kada osmijeh izgleda najprirodnijije.

r17.exp: 'Avoid fake smiles, you'll be ready (17)____.' → C: when someone grabs the camera to take your picture. Bit ćeš spreman/na kad netko uzme fotoaparat.

r18.exp: 'Ask friends to look at pictures (18)____.' → A: to help you decide when you look best. Prijatelji pomažu odlučiti kad izgledaš najbolje.

r19.exp: 'Pretend you saw something funny, (19)____.' → F: which will immediately relax your muscles. Zamisli nešto smiješno → opusti mišiće lica.

r20.exp: 'Avoid saying cheese (20)____.' → D: because it freezes your smile. 'Cheese' zamrzava osmijeh na licu.

r21.exp: 'Located on ITS own little island' — posvojni 'its' (bez apostrofa) za neživo. 'It's' = it is (pogrešno), 'his' = muško.

r22.exp: 'Between 1912 and 1932' = specifičan period u prošlosti → past simple passive: WAS reconstructed.

r23.exp: 'Reasons WHY it enjoys such status' — 'why' uvodi zavisnu surečenicu razloga uz 'reasons'.

r24.exp: 'You HAVE to go and discover it' — 'have to' = moraš (nužnost). Kontekst sugerira da trebaš osobno posjetiti.

r25.exp: 'Available IN eight languages' — prijedlog 'in' uz jezike: available in English/French/etc.

r26.exp: 'Used TO the idea' — fiksna kolokacija: be used to something = naviknuti na nešto.

r27.exp: 'A time WHEN it was not routine' — relativna zamjenica 'when' za vremenski antecedent (time).

r28.exp: 'Once we HAVE learned to read' — present perfect u vremenskoj surečenici s 'once' (čim smo naučili).

r29.exp: 'Look them UP in a dictionary' — frazalni glagol: look up = potražiti (u rječniku).

r30.exp: 'It was SUCH a new idea that...' — 'such' uz imeničku skupinu za naglašavanje (such a/an + adj + noun + that).

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) jesi li zadovoljan/na školom i zašto, (2) kakvi su ti razredni kolege i nastavnici, (3) što bi promijenio/la u školi. Dužina 50–70 riječi. Neformalan registar.

w1.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva pitanja), jezik i dužina (50–70 riječi). Stariji format — kraća dužina.
